{{Top|leg}}
A '''hover engine lifter''' or '''hover generator''' was a type of [[Hovercraft|hover]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. They were used in conjunction with [[repulsorlift booster]]s on the [[Hyperfoil 1000-XTC]] to provide vertical lift.
